title: John Jacob Jingleheimer Schmidt
transcription:
John Jacob Jingleheimer
Schmidt

John Jacob Jingleheimer Schmidt, that's
my name too,
Whenever I go out, the people always
shout:
"There goes John Jacob Jingleheimer
Schmidt!"

Caye-aye-aye-aye-aye-aye.

Get softer with the verse and louder
with the "Caye-aye's" each time until
verse is barely audible. Then end with
one last shout.
